rubric.evidence: WebIDL and participating tree roots algorithm verified directly against CSSWG #12953 (Nov 11, 2026 resolution), CSSWG PR #14826 patch, TAG #1315, Blink view_transition_options.idl, scoped_view_transition.idl, view_transition_supplement.cc, view_transition_style_tracker.cc, and ChromeStatus 5206462350622720.

Published at assigned v160/view-transitions-shadowroots-option-in-startviewtransition/ matching Chrome Platform Showcase v160 route and H1 listing name, while transparently noting that ChromeStatus currently lists desktop/android/webview 161 and Blink gates ViewTransitionShadowRoots as experimental.

reference-contract.json inventories StartViewTransitionOptions.shadowRoots and the participating tree roots resolution algorithm across all 9 dimensions and explicitly lists pre-existing dictionary members (update, types) in outOfScope.

Explains flat shared namespace semantics (cross-tree morphing and duplicate-name collisions), non-recursiveness of nested shadow roots, pseudo-element tree placement on the transition root, closed shadow root capability opt-in, and silent-ignore behavior on older engines.

Embeds verified 200 live Chrome Platform Showcase concept demo (shadow-card-morph/) with sandbox and referrerpolicy attributes, links all 3 sibling demos, and provides two complete semantic <pre><code> examples including reduced-motion CSS and focus management on transition.finished.

Separates base View Transitions Baseline Newly available status (webstatus.dev + BCD Document.json/Element.json) from Chromium-only shadowRoots status (ChromeStatus 161 target, ViewTransitionShadowRoots flag, Mozilla #1488, WebKit #743).

Zero unlinked citation labels; all external links carry target='_blank' rel='noopener'; full 16-digit ChromeStatus ID 5206462350622720; incidental feature-root showcase link in At a glance marked data-demo-rel='related' so the embedded concept iframe is cleanly selected as the primary demo.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions with aria-labelledby and :focus-visible outline, titled iframe, and examples incorporating prefers-reduced-motion and focus routing.
Uses shared /public/styles.css layout, .local-nav jump bar, display: block + inline-size: 100% on embedded iframe, and horizontally scrollable tables without horizontal document overflow.

Verified 200 on https://chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v160/view-transitions-shadowroots-option-in-startviewtransition/shadow-card-morph/ with matching parent conformance suite (release v160, featureSlug view-transitions-shadowroots-option-in-startviewtransition, chromestatusId 5206462350622720).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Check for startViewTransition support for progressive enhancement, enforce unique view-transition-name values, disable animations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, and route keyboard focus programmatically once transition.finished resolves.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied in #examples and #lifecycle: custom-element example feature-detects startViewTransition, includes @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) animation reset, and routes focus to the updated heading in transition.finished.finally().

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible documentation landmarks headings tables dark mode typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), sequential headings, captioned data tables with <th scope>, and visible :focus-visible outlines on focusable scroll regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, sequential h1/h2/h3 hierarchy, captioned tables with <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap regions with aria-labelledby, and titled iframe.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation table scroll navigation without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size, inline-size), display: block on <iframe> to avoid inline baseline gaps, and overflow: auto for wide tables without overflow: hidden clipping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100%, .example-embed iframe uses display: block and inline-size: 100%, and shared /public/styles.css handles wrapping and scrolling.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible documentation landmarks headings tables dark mode typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use shared semantic color tokens for automatic light/dark adaptation rather than conflicting inline overrides.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: inherits /public/styles.css semantic tokens and light-dark variables with minimal page-specific rules.
